scope: frozen chronological test split; same event cohort for all arms
bootstrap_unit: paired whole match within gender; same draws for both innings and all arms

importance.method: marginal permutation of raw input columns
importance.models: four fixed-IBW models with validation-selected algorithms and parameters
importance.dataset: complete frozen test split per track
importance.units: each actual model input and nonempty disjoint state/resource/interaction blocks
importance.permutation: within track across events; shared row permutation within each block
importance.uncertainty: sample standard deviation across permutations; not a confidence interval
importance.purpose: descriptive model reliance only; no feature selection or model promotion
importance.constant_model: not applicable: no input features; never fabricate zero feature scores

selection_scope: IBW only; inherit Stage 07 within-arm algorithm and parameter selection
